situation: A software business selling online booking to clinics through paid and organic search.
complication: Paid leads now cost more than before, and the main product page wastes its ranking with a weak title.
key_question: Which search changes would lower the client's cost per lead?

titles.situation: Paid search leads are getting more expensive.
titles.options: Two ways to lower the cost of a lead.
titles.recommendation: Test lower branded bids and fix the main page title.
titles.roadmap: Fix the title and ads first, then test branded bids.
titles.kpis: Two measures show search is getting cheaper per lead.
titles.risks: The main risk is losing branded leads to competitors.

figures.label: Share of spend on branded keywords

issue_tree.finding: Each paid lead now costs noticeably more.
points: Cost per lead rose from [F4] to [F2].

hypotheses.text: Competitors bid up the client's core terms.

issue_tree.so_what: Without changes the same budget buys fewer leads.

chart.title: Cost per lead rose from its earlier level.

issue_tree.finding: A large slice of spend goes on searches that already name the business.

hypotheses.text: Branded searchers would find the business through organic results anyway.

issue_tree.so_what: A controlled test shows whether that spend can move to new searches.

issue_tree.finding: The main product page wastes its ranking on a weak title.
points: The page ranks for the client's core term, but its title is just the word Home.

hypotheses.text: A descriptive title would win more clicks from the same ranking.

issue_tree.so_what: A clear title and description cost nothing in ad spend.

options.name: Rebalance and retitle
options.description: Test lower branded bids, move the savings to core terms, and rewrite the main page title and ads.

options.name: Cut spend
options.description: Reduce the monthly budget until cost per lead falls.

recommendation.rationale: It tackles [F3] of branded spend and a free organic fix together; the marketing manager approves every page, ad and bid change before it goes live.
